support_claim: Evidence associates Meridian Energy Partners LLC with billing activity and names it as counterparty on MSA-MER-2024, but no proposition establishes that billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC and contract:MSA-MER-2024 denote the same legal counterparty.

propositions.proposition: Meridian Energy Partners invoices are described as the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.
propositions.relevance: Associates billing activity for Meridian Energy Partners with the contract referent MSA-MER-2024, but does not establish that the billing referent and the contract referent denote the same legal counterparty.

propositions.proposition: The billed name recorded in billing data is Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the left referent billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC to the legal-entity name Meridian Energy Partners LLC.

propositions.proposition: MSA-MER-2024 is titled Advisory retainer and lists Counterparty: Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the right referent contract:MSA-MER-2024 to an agreement whose named counterparty is Meridian Energy Partners LLC; this names a party to the contract but does not establish identity between the contract referent and the billing referent.

propositions.proposition: Section 9 Assignment of MSA-MER-2024 states that Meridian Energy Partners LLC may not assign the agreement to a competitor of the provider.
propositions.relevance: Further identifies Meridian Energy Partners LLC as the contracting party under MSA-MER-2024 without establishing referent identity between billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC and contract:MSA-MER-2024.
